page.overview:
What is Rikukurage?

Toedscruel resembles its /-type counterpart, Tentacruel, except the top of its head and its nose are black with beige spots. its tentacles are also very light with yellow spots on the tips.

Toedscruel live in colonies deep in forests, and do not appreciate strangers. It moves by jumping around on its springy tentacles.

Toedscruel have strong tentacles to bind prey, and have the ability to siphon the energy of said prey.

Toedscruel evolves from Toedscool starting at level 30.
